sc: Players can obtain the hide via hunting an archaemastyx or buying it from the Smuggler.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.

The Third Age-dyed augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow is a level 92 Ranged off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Off-hand blightbound crossbow (Third Age), or by using Third Age dye on an augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow.
To obtain a cavalier, a player can either trade with another player or rarely receive one when opening a hard reward casket.
A bloodcap mushroom is obtained by picking bloodcap mushrooms west of the Tirannwn mushroom patch.
Blue crab & gissel potato is a unique food used in the Dungeoneering skill and can only be found in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a Baked cave potato with cooked Blue crab and a Gissel mushroom.
This item can only be made by members.
It can be re-obtained from Aksel if you have left the area after obtaining it.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 5 elder rune bars, requiring 5,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 5,000 Smithing experience.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is a coordinate clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
It is obtained by cleaning the fireplace that is located in the west room upstairs in Fenkenstrain's Castle with an extended brush.
Players can obtain this item either by trading with another player, or by receiving it as a very rare drop from killing Revenants or the Chaos Elemental.
The cracked cooking urn (full) is an item made by filling a cracked cooking urn while cooking food.
They can also be obtained as a drop in the Temple of Aminishi, the Shadow Reef and the Zamorakian Undercity.

They are obtained by upgrading the tier 80 variant with 2 pieces of greater ensouled cloth, 2 spools of greater ensouled thread, and 20 necrotic runes of each type after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VII.
A deathweed robe top is tier 6 necromancy tank body armour available in Daemonheim as part of the deathweed armour set.
It is made from ensouled duskweed cloth and ensouled thread with level 58 Crafting.
It can be created from 3,600 divination fragments with level 80 Divination and 20 Invention.
It could also be obtained from Treasure Hunter on 13 and 15, and 16 November 2015.
The dried grapes are an item obtained during the Great Egg-spectations quest by leaving some grapes out on the washing line in the Garden of Kharid.

Elder rune armour set + 1.x: Elder rune armour set + 1 is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: The emerald necklace is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with a cut emerald and a necklace mould in the backpack (or tool belt).
The exquisite mining urn (empty) is created by using an earth rune on an exquisite mining urn (no rune).
It is made by using one soft porcelain clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 102 Crafting and granting 78 experience.
The flameproof aura is a tier 1 aura that can be bought from Solomon's General Store for 5,000 Loyalty Points.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought, so total cost for a specific tier of flameproof aura is the cumulative cost in the following table.
It was made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which had to be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.
The helm could hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.

sc: This item is dropped by abyssal leeches, abyssal walkers, and abyssal guardians or can be bought from Wizard Korvak in the Runecrafting Guild for 50,000 coins.
It used to be the largest Runecrafting pouch that could be obtained, but was surpassed by the massive pouch, released on 30 April 2012.
The golden cane is an item introduced on 2 February 2015 that became available from the rare token store on 12 March 2015.
Gorvek's head is a boss trophy obtained from defeating Vindicta & Gorvek.
A Hawai'i parasol is a parasol that is unlocked after consuming a Hawai'i parasol token.
It is one of five parasols available to be obtained from the tokens available throughout the duration of the Summer Beach Party (2017).
A Herblore XP lamp is a quest item given as a reward for completing Hearts of Sanguine.
The huge lock is a Treasure Hunter reward obtained from the Chainlink promotion.
Ilujankan Traveller's Off-Hand Chakram is an off-hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 38 of the Journey to Iaia Yak Track with the premier pass.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 iron bars and an iron scimitar, requiring 320 progress to complete, granting a total of 80 Smithing experience.
Items given to the player by Fest NPCs are automatically added to the basket.

sc: Teak logs are logs obtained through the Woodcutting skill by cutting teak trees, requiring level 30 Woodcutting and giving 85 experience.
These logs can be gathered by your subjects in Managing Miscellania after completing Royal Trouble, however you will not receive the special variety.

w: Gu: Warriors of the Magic Mountain
sc: The tengu tsuba is a reward in the player-owned port minigame.
One tengu tsuba is also the reward from the second Guardians of the World trio special voyage: Gu: Warriors of the Magic Mountain.
It can be obtained during the Tomes of the Warlock quest by talking to Wizard Borann at the Wizards' Tower.

The TokHaar-Kal-Mej (translated as Sacred-Rock of the victorious mage) is a high-level mage cape obtained by completing the Fight Kiln minigame, using Magic for the majority of the activity, or in equal measure with other combat styles.
It is created by using blue dye on a vial of red mist.
It is used to be able to get into Zemouregal's bedroom in the castle in New Varrock to obtain the vault key.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 74 spirit shards, a blue charm, and a spinner charm in the backpack, requiring 34 Summoning and giving 59.
It can be made into ten Void scrolls (Call to Arms) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.
The red voting hat is an item that can be bought from Faruq's Tools for Games in Al Kharid.
White logs are created by using a white firelighter (obtainable from completing any clue scroll) on some normal logs.
They can also be purchased at any of the crossbow shops listed below.
Wings of the Twin Furies is a boss trophy obtained from defeating the Twin Furies.
The wolpertinger companion pet token was a reward available at NovtumberFest.
